deviceType: Reduced pressure zone assembly — selected official service parts
title: FEBCO 825Y repair kits by size, check seat, and rubber service
description: Identify the FEBCO 825Y-family label and select the manufacturer-published check-seat or complete-rubber service reference for the matching size band.
summary: The 825Y family includes original, angle, and lead-free variants. This map keeps original and LF part paths separate rather than treating every 825Y-looking body as interchangeable.
statusNote: Confirm 825Y versus LF825Y and the nominal size before ordering. This page does not claim to cover every relief-valve, check, or sensor configuration in the wider 825Y family.
diagramAlt: Reduced pressure zone assembly showing check-valve covers and central relief-valve zone
identifiers: Read the full marking: 825Y, 825YA, LF825Y, and LF825YA are related but may use different published kit references.
A check-seat-and-ring kit is not a complete rubber-parts kit, and neither should be treated as a full internal rebuild.
Flood-sensor accessories appear alongside repair parts on manufacturer records but are not internal repair kits.
